description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing workout session data within a fitness tracking application. It includes state management for sessions, loading state, and error handling, as well as CRUD operations interfacing with an API and integrating with an authentication context.

methods.name: WorkoutProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides workout session state and actions (list, add, update, delete) to its children.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of workout sessions from the API and updates local state.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new workout session via API call and updates local state.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates an existing workout session via API call and updates local state.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a workout session via API call and updates local state.
